title: A single ideal multiplication-kernel element dies at a later stage
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $A,B:\Lambda\to\mathrm{CommRing}$, $N:\Lambda\to\mathrm{Ab}$ functors with specified categorical colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Write $\alpha_f,\beta_f,\eta_f$ for their transition maps and $a_i,b_i,n_i$ for their coprojections. Give each $N_i$ a $B_i$-module structure satisfying $\eta_f(bx)=\beta_f(b)\eta_f(x)$. Let $\varphi_i:A_i\to B_i$ satisfy $\beta_f\varphi_i=\varphi_j\alpha_f$, and let $\psi:A_\infty\to B_\infty$ satisfy $\psi a_i=b_i\varphi_i$. Give $N_\infty$ a $B_\infty$-module structure with $n_i(bx)=b_i(b)n_i(x)$, and assume it is flat over $A_\infty$ through $\psi$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Fix $i$, any ideal $I\subset A_i$, and any $k\in I\otimes_{A_i}N_i$ whose multiplication in $N_i$ is zero. There exist $j$, $f:i\to j$, and an additive map $\theta:I\otimes_{A_i}N_i\to (I.\mathrm{map}(\alpha_f))\otimes_{A_j}N_j$ such that $\theta(a\otimes x)=\alpha_f(a)\otimes\eta_f(x)$ for every $a\in I$, $x\in N_i$, and $\theta(k)=0$. The $A_i,A_j$ actions are through $\varphi_i,\varphi_j$. No Noetherian, local-ring or finite-module assumption is imposed.

source.place: Algebra, Tags 00R6 and 00HK, descent of one kernel element and equational flatness.

proof.text: Write k as sum_p a_p tensor x_p using TensorProduct.exists_sum_tmul_eq. The multiplication-zero hypothesis becomes sum_p phi_i(a_p)*x_p=0.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-flat-relation-descent] to this finite relation. Obtain j, f, coefficients c_pq in A_j and y_q in N_j with eta_f(x_p)=sum_q phi_j(c_pq)*y_q and sum_p alpha_f(a_p)*c_pq=0 for all q.

Construct the canonical tensor map by TensorProduct.map on the semilinear ideal map and module map. Expanding its value on k and using the row equations gives sum_p sum_q alpha_f(a_p) tensor phi_j(c_pq)*y_q. Tensor balancing moves c_pq to the ideal factor. Interchange the finite sums and use additivity in the ideal factor: each q-term becomes (sum_p c_pq*alpha_f(a_p)) tensor y_q. Commutativity and the column equations make each ideal factor zero. Thus theta(k)=0.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00R6 kernel descent, using the equivalent finite-relation form of flatness in Tag 00HK; actual Lean assembly uses finite sums and balancing instead of tensor colimits.

theorem exists_stage_ideal_kernel_element_vanishes
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty Λ]
    (A : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (N : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) [HasColimit A] [HasColimit B] [HasColimit N]
    [∀ i, Module (B.obj i) (N.obj i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i)
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      (B.map f).hom.comp (φ i) = (φ j).comp (A.map f).hom)
    (hscalar : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (N.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (N.map f).hom x)
    (ψ : (colimit A : CommRingCat.{u}) →+* (colimit B : CommRingCat.{u}))
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι A i).hom = (colimit.ι B i).hom.comp (φ i))
    [Module (colimit B : CommRingCat.{u}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (hlimitScalar : ∀ (i : Λ) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (colimit.ι N i).hom (b • x) = (colimit.ι B i).hom b • (colimit.ι N i).hom x)
    (hflat : letI := Module.compHom (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ψ
      Module.Flat (colimit A : CommRingCat.{u}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (i : Λ) (I : Ideal (A.obj i)) :
    letI := Module.compHom (N.obj i) (φ i)
    ∀ (k : I ⊗[A.obj i] N.obj i),
      TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.lsmul (A.obj i) (N.obj i)).comp I.subtype) k = 0 →
    ∃ (j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      letI := Module.compHom (N.obj i) (φ i)
      letI := Module.compHom (N.obj j) (φ j)
      ∃ θ : I ⊗[A.obj i] N.obj i →+
          (I.map (A.map f).hom) ⊗[A.obj j] N.obj j,
        (∀ (a : I) (x : N.obj i), θ (a ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] x) =
          (⟨(A.map f).hom a, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (A.map f).hom a.property⟩ :
            I.map (A.map f).hom) ⊗ₜ[A.obj j] (N.map f).hom x) ∧
        θ k = 0
